title: Rice Titan Harvester
raw_idea:
Rice Titan Harvester
A skyscraper-sized walking machine that strides across entire paddy fields, harvesting thousands of rice plants with colossal articulated arms. Its giant belly contains an automated threshing, drying, and grain-storage complex.
description: A skyscraper-sized walking machine that strides across entire paddy fields, harvesting thousands of rice plants with colossal articulated arms. Its giant belly contains an automated threshing, drying, and grain-storage complex.

title: The Paddy Ocean Vacuum
raw_idea:
The Paddy Ocean Vacuum
A kilometer-long floating megamachine that hovers just above flooded rice fields and gently vacuum-lifts mature rice panicles from the plants. The harvested grain travels through enormous transparent tubes into mobile silos trailing behind it.
description: A kilometer-long floating megamachine that hovers just above flooded rice fields and gently vacuum-lifts mature rice panicles from the plants. The harvested grain travels through enormous transparent tubes into mobile silos trailing behind it.

title: Rice-Field Spider Colossus
raw_idea:
Rice-Field Spider Colossus
An eight-legged titan whose enormous feet can step between paddy plots while robotic limbs harvest individual sections. Its central body acts as a gigantic rice mill, turning freshly harvested paddy into polished rice as it moves.

title: The Monsoon Harvesting Ark
raw_idea:
The Monsoon Harvesting Ark
A colossal amphibious machine shaped like a futuristic ark, capable of traveling through flooded paddies without damaging the fields. Its massive side-mounted harvesters sweep through acres of rice while onboard systems separate straw, husk, and grain.

title: Paddy Ring Megaharvester
raw_idea:
Paddy Ring Megaharvester
An immense circular machine several kilometers across that surrounds an entire rice-growing region. As the ring slowly contracts, synchronized harvesting arms collect mature rice from every field toward a gigantic central processing station.
description: An immense circular machine several kilometers across that surrounds an entire rice-growing region. As the ring slowly contracts, synchronized harvesting arms collect mature rice from every field toward a gigantic central processing station.

title: Sky Reaper Rice Fortress
raw_idea:
Sky Reaper Rice Fortress

title: The Rice Comb Superstructure

The Rice Comb Superstructure

title: Paddy-Gulping Harvest Worm

Paddy-Gulping Harvest Worm

title: Rice Moon Harvester
raw_idea:
Rice Moon Harvester

title: The Infinite Rice Factory
raw_idea:
The Infinite Rice Factory
A city-sized autonomous machine that combines harvester, threshing plant, dryer, rice mill, packaging facility, and grain silo into one continuously moving megastructure. It enters a paddy region at harvest season and theoretically leaves behind completely harvested, processed, packaged rice—without ever stopping.

The Wheat Ocean Harvester
